title: Add RAG agent templates, tool-calling quickstarts, and docs site updates
author: Priya Shah
description: Summary: Add a set of reusable RAG agent templates, three tool-calling quickstarts (Python/TS/Go), and the corresponding docs site updates. Motivation: make it easier for engineers to onboard RAG + agent workflows with Redwood by providing opinionated templates and end-to-end examples that demonstrate retrieval, tool-calling, and structured output. What changed: 1) new directory redwood-examples/rag-agents with 3 templates (customer-support, knowledge-assistant, finance-recon) and README with usage/limitations; 2) quickstarts under redwood-quickstarts showing tool-calling integrations for Python, TypeScript, and Go with minimal infra config; 3) docs site updates (redwood-docs) to add a new "Agents & RAG" section, quickstart pages, and code snippets for SDKs; 4) small utilities in redwood to expose a light-weight retriever interface and an examples-only fixture for CI. Checklist: - [x] Add agent templates and sample data - [x] Add SDK usage examples for all three languages - [x] Docs pages with screenshots and step-by-step - [x] CI smoke tests for examples - [x] Confirm license and attribution for sample dataset Limitations: these are quickstarts intended for demo and onboarding only, not production-ready pipelines; retriever in redwood package is intentionally minimal and marked experimental. Related: ENG-1428 (RAG templates initiative), PM-331 (docs sprint).
